mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND deleted = false
SELECT r.role_code FROM rel_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = false WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND ur.deleted = false

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM rel_user_role ur JOIN rel_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id AND rp.deleted = false JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.deleted = false WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND ur.deleted = false
